t: This is 101 to 104 Piccadilly, a building in the City of Westminster. It was designed by Robert William Edis, who was a British architect and held the rank of Colonel, and later Sir. That's about all the material I have on this one, so take a moment to look at the frontage along Piccadilly and see what you make of it. It's a good spot to notice how the street's buildings sit side by side, each the work of a different designer.
